integrity: The claims are derived analytically from four unbiased binomial moments and exact three-node quadrature. Exact-integer and rational checks reproduce the stated finite classification and sample Gram matrices. No independent external audit or bibliographic completeness certification.
scientific_limitations: Only positive probabilities uniform on exactly three complete Hamming shells for the degree-at-most-two Walsh band; no claim concerning arbitrary irregular point sets, minimal vertex count or all higher-band designs. First nonuniqueness dimension is verified by an executable exhaustive integer certificate over a finite range, combined with a proof that the enumerator is complete; infinite families follow symbolically.
title: Three-shell Parseval sampling for the quadratic Walsh band: arithmetic classification and Pell nonuniqueness
